讚美之泉
詞、曲：游智婷 Sandy Yu

lines.a: 願我 我的禱告 如香陳列在祢面前
lines.b: Let my praises arise as an incense, burning for You

lines.a: 沒有黑暗勢力 可以搖動我的信心
lines.b: There's no power on earth, nothing can shake my faith in You

lines.a: 願我 我的敬拜 到祢面前 蒙祢悅納
lines.b: Let my worship arise as a pleasing sacrifice

lines.a: 天使天軍屈膝 俯伏敬拜 在祢寶座前
lines.b: Let all angels and saints bow before You at Your throne

lines.a: 打開天窗 打開天窗
lines.b: Open the gates of heaven, I pray
Lord, hear my cries and open the gates

lines.a: 願祢充滿 祢的榮耀
lines.b: I want to see, see Your face
Let Your glory fill this place
